"How do you know so much about so many things?"

Kevin Trudeau tells of a dinner where guests asked him exactly that. He was talking about Krishna and the history of the Bhagavad Gita, and they thought he knew it better than a scholar.

His answer was two words: "I read." Kevin says leaders are always readers, and anyone who wants more has to be curious and invest time in learning.

When did you last learn something just because you were curious?
